content:
Ivy (CS): Quick flag 1: SilverNeedle's onboarding instance had median latency jump ~20% during their promo burst. They're showing early renewal sensitivity. Proposing a low-risk perf play: small int8 canary + split routing for templated short prompts + longer prefix cache TTL. Thoughts? :triage_flag:

Diego (SRE): +1. Plan: 1) 5% canary -> redwood-compact-l1-int8 2) Route requests with <=200 tokens to compact 3) prefix_ttl -> 900s. Add auto-fallback to standard model. Should cut short-path median by ~25-35%.

Sam (Solutions): On quality, our sample eval shows compact-l1-int8 has ~0.7% delta on our intent scorer for SilverNeedle prompts, minimal hallucinations. Recommend running the eval harness and a quick regression scorer before moving beyond 10%. Also propose conservative decoding presets as mitigation.

Lena (AM): SilverNeedle will want an estimated cost delta for renewal talk next week. Can we get per-token compute savings and a one-slide comparison?

Diego (SRE): Draft routing policy for staging (will validate in infra):

```yaml
routes:
  - id: silverneedle-short
    match: request.tokens <= 200
    rollout:
      - model: redwood-compact-l1-int8
        percent: 5
      - model: redwood-standard-v3
        percent: 95
    fallback: redwood-standard-v3
    cache: { prefix_ttl: 900s }
```

deploy-bot: Canary job queued (#canary-silverneedle-615555)  running compact-l1-int8 eval suite. Link: https://ci.internal/canaries/615555

Diego (SRE): 30m snapshot: median -28% on short-path, p95 -10%, eval intent -0.6%. No error uptick. If stable, move to 10% and prepare results for Lena's slide.

Ivy (CS): I'll book a 20m sync with SilverNeedle Tue 11am ET to present the plan and get their risk tolerance. Action items: Diego -> finish eval + 10% run by Mon EOD; Sam -> short quality note + mitigation knobs; Lena -> cost delta slide. Will capture customer feedback on the call. :calendar:
